items.headline: Latest updates on how the FAA ground stop will affect college football
items.description: The SEC Now crew provides updates on how games are being affected by transportation issues as Chris Doering and Benjamin Watson analyze the impact on players.

items.headline: Chris Doering dissects key storylines in three Week 11 matchups
items.description: Doering weighs Saturday matchups and acknowledges key factors on both sides of the ball, highlighting "one of the hottest team in the country right now" in the No. 17 Gamecocks.

items.headline: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
items.description: Travel plans for multiple sports have been disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.

items.headline: Gene Chizik's 'Words of Chizdom' to a few teams who may need a lift
items.description: Chizik provides reasons to keep believing to a few SEC programs navigating adversity as the College Football Playoffs approach.

items.headline: College Football Playoff Bubble Watch after second ranking
items.description: A conference-by-conference look at which teams are contending for the playoff, who's close, and who's out.

items.headline: Missouri's Eli Drinkwitz questions need for conferences in 24-team CFP era
items.description: Missouri's Eli Drinkwitz became the latest coach from a Power 4 school to ask if conferences are necessary anymore without title games in the 24-team CFP era.
